newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian hacks six to death after wife's funeral.
newsitem.headline: Russian hacks six to death after wife's funeral.

text.p: A Russian pensioner hacked six fellow mourners to death with an axe on Sunday after his wife's funeral, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Ivan Likharev, who is in his 60s, "could not even remember what started the quarrel".
Neighbours called police to his house in the village of Verkhneye Moshevo, near Perm in the northern Urals. They found two bodies lying in the garden and another four indoors.
Tass did not say whether the victims were members of the dead woman's family.
